blockers.title: Deletion-log-only source invalidation is not fenced
blockers.reason: The new raw portfolio/current-work guard does not read wft_deletions. Real sync saves a merged newer deletion log independently at saveDeletionsLocalOnly,then can await settings network work before portfolio filtering/persistence. Confirmation can arrive in that interval:portfolio bytes,settings,current writing and pending still match,so this preview loads a source that the new tombstone already excludes and clears acknowledged current/pending work. The public Remove Entry regression removes the portfolio entry too,so it does not cover this deletion-only interval.

blockers.smallest_required_change: Add one recovery-aware raw deletion-log field to readCurrentWork,for example storedDeletions: readWftStudentChangeStorage(WFT_DELETIONS_STORAGE_KEY). It is then captured before the dialog and compared at the existing synchronous post-confirm gate;read failures use the existing catch. Use raw bytes,not normalized getDeletionsData,which can swallow errors and introduce generated defaults. No sync engine change or source normalization write is needed.
blockers.required_regression: While the real confirmation is held,write a strictly newer source/student tombstone through the same real saveDeletionsLocalOnly helper(or native deletion pull held before portfolio sync). Assert matching source is excluded by actual deletion policy while portfolio/settings/selection/current work/pending bytes remain otherwise unchanged,then confirm and require review/retry with every current-work field retained. This may use a labeled controlled sync-writer seam;do not claim a real cloud journey. Retain all15 existing cases and exact-source receipts.
blockers.policy_scope: New tombstone arrival during the held dialog belongs to the existing freshness repair. This does not request migration of older deleted entries,a new global lock or a general cross-tab transaction.

accepted_as_implemented.assessment: 7627-7631 refuses unresolved recovery,reads one logical raw portfolio snapshot,validates/normalizes that same value and locates source with existing stable-ID-first/createdAt selector. It avoids the soft display reader failure fallback and derives text/grade/images from the bound source.

It does not call the impure current-writing context helper on rejection.

7688-7700 compares before the unchanged original grade/load body begins7702. Both failed reads and changed snapshots alert/return;Cancel returns before the gate. No post-confirm await separates the gate from initial synchronous load.

accepted_as_implemented.requirement: Runtime plus stored pending and acknowledged-existing compatibility
accepted_as_implemented.assessment: Opening getPendingPortfolioSync hydration is preserved before snapshot/warning. Snapshot compares full runtime content plus raw persisted bytes and validates persisted named-student/object-session shape. Unchanged existing pending remains allowed;late same-ID/signature storage-only change is detected.

Only one normalized source object is used;acceptance compares stored raw portfolio bytes rather than regenerated normalized IDs/date defaults. No-date stable-ID and direct createdAt-selector cases explicitly hold the modal across20ms. No storage normalization is written by the guard.

Strict source and pending read/parse failures have bounded catches before load;truthy student-change recovery aborts before/after dialog. Byte comparison need not reparse changed source because any change is rejected. The complete original grade-failure,image-restore-context and missing-source replacement behavior outside the added gate is byte-identical.

accepted_tradeoffs: Any raw portfolio change,including unrelated student writes or equivalent serialization,requires a new action. This conservative retry policy is explicit in the code and avoids a new per-record identity/fingerprint framework.
Any stored settings/selection change and full current-work value change also requires retry. The snapshot stays local to the held operation and is not logged/exported by the patch.
A synchronous check establishes freshness at confirmation acceptance;it is not a cross-tab atomic transaction or a lock on later work. Existing image/replacement guards remain necessary.

The id-less createdAt compatibility control enters the public function directly. It does not establish that existing generated-ID renderer buttons are a stable legacy API;this preview does not change that pre-existing rendering behavior.
Recovery-refusal branches are source-inspected,not backed by a new dedicated recovery injection. This is a disclosed test limit,not a reason to remove the recovery guards.
